scope: Four owner-requested12-second review tests, rebuilding owner-rejected v1; not full new episodes

contracts.invariant: The same two photographic fracture surfaces remain in the same material coordinates.
contracts.operation: Open the fracture; follow water into its actual alpha-derived void; dissolve calcium from the exposed lime; grow textured mineral facets inward from the fracture walls.
states: Water enters the actual fracture mask
Calcium becomes suspended in the water
Mineral begins growing from both walls
contracts.truth_boundary: Illustrative generated material; highly accelerated conceptual mechanism, not archaeological footage or a measured healing rate. Facet growth illustrates deposition, not exact crystal morphology.

contracts.invariant: Both source-derived island cutouts, boundary and route retain one common geographic transform.
contracts.operation: Rotate and enlarge the same island relationship, reveal the date boundary, then carry a date-bearing traveller across it.
states: Reframe the geography with north indicator
Draw the boundary in source coordinates
Traveller changes MON to TUE at boundary
contracts.truth_boundary: NASA photographic coast cutouts selected from source pixels, not surveyed GIS. Monday/Tuesday are example days; no always-different-date or exact24-hour claim. Boundary is schematic.

contracts.invariant: Movable finger stays attached to the fixed photographic claw; the projected jet begins at the socket region.
contracts.operation: Establish specimen, cut into an articulated photographic macro rig, close the movable finger, emit a water jet, form a toroidal illustrative cavity, then collapse it before the pressure pulse.
states: Hard inspection cut to component rig
contracts.truth_boundary: Generated specimen/components and external hinge illustration, not measured anatomy or high-speed footage. Jet direction projected; cavity enlarged/slowed, not to scale; synthesized sound not authentic shrimp audio.

contracts.invariant: The scale compares equal fluid volumes; the conceptual terrain is explicitly distinguished from the NOAA photograph.
contracts.operation: Locate a real seafloor lake, introduce an equal-volume balance, tip the denser brine side, remove that comparison, then show independent brine flow over a terrain bank collecting below.
contracts.truth_boundary: Generated conceptual diorama is not a reconstruction of measured NOAA terrain. Assigned fluid colors; balance is an explanatory diagram. No impossible pour through a sealed vessel or scale pan.

hold_exceptions.9.4-10.9: Resolved mechanism and complete narration tail before exact shared ending
